about: The landlord emailed on 2026-09-20 that rent goes from $1,850 to $2,100 from 2026-11-01, mid-way through a one-year lease, after the tenant's written complaint of 2026-09-05. Expected: rent_increased active (a repair suggestion, if any, answered no); the playbook has no clocks, so no deadline. start: I rent a house in Gainesville on a one-year lease. My rent is $1,850 a month.
On September 20, 2026 the landlord emailed me that my rent goes up to $2,100 starting November 1, 2026.
On September 5, 2026 I had complained in writing about the broken water heater.

What was it? If more than one: a written notice to the landlord about a repair

chat: Can my landlord raise the rent in the middle of my lease?
Is this retaliation for my complaint?
